numerical_claims.source_value: SEK -0.25 (2025) vs SEK -0.18 (2024) (Key Ratios & Multi-year summary)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios section page 4 and Multi-year summary page 15 confirm EPS figures.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities improved to SEK -20,011,617 from SEK -27,117,256 in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement page 23 shows operating cash flow for both years.

numerical_claims.claim: Total cash flow including financing activities turned positive at SEK 6,516,117, compared to SEK -12,758,133 in the preceding year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement page 23 shows total cash flow for both years.

numerical_claims.claim: The positive total cash flow was supported by completed financing activities, including a directed share issue that provided approximately SEK 33.5 million before issue costs, along with loan facilities and credit arrangements.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: SEK 33.5 million from directed share issue
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 33.5 million before issue costs from directed share issue (Directors' Report)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Directors' Report page 16: 'In total, 23,110,342 shares were issued, providing the company with approximately SEK 33.5 million before issue costs.'

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and bank balances at the end of 2025 increased to SEK 8,748,046 from SEK 2,231,929 at the end of 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 8,748,046 (2025) vs SEK 2,231,929 (2024) (Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Statement)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet page 21 and Cash Flow Statement page 23 show year-end cash positions.

numerical_claims.claim: Total equity at year-end stood at SEK 109,778,755 with an equity ratio of 71.8 percent, compared to SEK 110,540,939 and 80.8 percent in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 109,778,755 (2025) vs SEK 110,540,939 (2024), 71.8% vs 80.8% equity ratio (Equity & Liabilities & Key Ratios)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Equity and Liabilities page 22 shows total equity. Key Ratios section page 4 and Multi-year summary page 15 confirm equity ratio percentages.

numerical_claims.claim: Annual savings of approximately SEK 25 million from 2026 onwards through structural cost reduction.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 25 million annual savings from 2026 (Directors' Report)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Directors' Report page 15: 'the company initiated a structural cost reduction... expected to decrease by approximately 40 percent, corresponding to annual savings of approximately SEK 25 million from 2026 onwards.'
